# Rays

> Rays is a free, open-source (AGPL-3.0) download manager for macOS 26 by a6n. It downloads each file in parts over several connections, and its sorter moves new files into folders that fit them using Apple's on-device model. One command, `dl`, covers downloads, sorting and an MCP server for AI assistants.

## Install

- [Download Rays.dmg](https://github.com/a6n-ai/rays/releases/latest/download/Rays.dmg): open it and drag Rays to Applications. On first open, approve it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
- Homebrew: `brew install --cask a6n-ai/tap/rays` (also puts `dl` on PATH; no Gatekeeper step).
- `dl` ships inside Rays.app; DMG installs add it to PATH from Settings > General > Command line tool.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/getting-started/): install, first download, turn on sorting.
- [Install](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/install/), [Downloads](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/app/downloads/), [Sorter](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/app/sorter/), [Browser extension](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/app/browser/) ([Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mgepiogdappnhmohefhalmeppkfciail), [Firefox Add-ons](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/rays@a6n.ai/)), [Settings](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/app/settings/), [S3 buckets](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/s3/), [MCP](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/mcp/), [Troubleshooting](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/troubleshooting/).
- [The dl command](https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/dl/): `dl URL...`, `dl s3://BUCKET/KEY`, `dl bucket`, `dl ls`, `dl list`, `dl sort`, `dl watch`, `dl status`, `dl config`, `dl mcp`, exit codes and environment variables.
- [Release notes](https://rays.a6n.ai/releases/): what changed in each version.
- [Source code](https://github.com/a6n-ai/rays): Rust engine, SwiftUI app, `dl` CLI, sorter, browser extension.

## MCP

- Start the server with `dl mcp` (stdio). Claude Code: `claude mcp add rays -- dl mcp`. Any client: `{"command": "dl", "args": ["mcp"]}`.
- Tools: `add_downloads` (http/https/s3 links), `list_downloads`, `list_buckets`, `browse_bucket`, `sorter_status`, `sort_folder` (dry run unless `dry_run` is false).

## Facts

- Requires macOS 26 or later. No account; sorting runs on the Mac and nothing is uploaded.
- Each download starts on one connection; files of 4 MB or more add connections, up to 16, only while each makes the download faster (details: https://rays.a6n.ai/docs/engine/); up to 5 automatic retries; downloads resume after pause or quit.
- S3 buckets: AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces, Google Cloud Storage (HMAC), Hetzner, Linode, Scaleway, OVHcloud, Oracle, Alibaba OSS, Supabase, Tigris, MinIO and any S3-compatible endpoint. Secret keys stay in the macOS Keychain; MCP cannot add buckets.
- Sorter categories: Work, Personal, Images, Installers, Archives, Media, Code, Other.

- [a6n](https://a6n.ai): the team that makes Rays. Contact hi@a6n.ai.
